name: HH 80-81

paper.title: Resolving the Circumstellar Disk Around the Massive Protostar Driving the HH 80-81 Jet

notes: Massive protostar (~17 Msun) driving the HH 80-81 jet, one of the most powerful known from a young star. VLA (7mm, 1.3cm, 3.6cm) + SMA (860um) resolve a compact disk-like structure perpendicular to the jet axis (Carrasco-Gonzalez et al. 2012, arXiv:1205.3302). Distance ~1.7 kpc (kinematic).
